I made the change and the full test suite passes (`mvn -q -o test`, no failures). I didn't add a test for the cancelled case.

The fix is in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`, in the `PURCHASE_ORDERS` entry of `CustomerAttributedRecords`. It now carries the same `status <> 'CANCELLED'` exclusion that the order and invoice counts use. I also changed its comment from "counted too" to "not counted".

The report shares one counting query with the other per-rep counts. Reps with no purchase orders in the period are still listed with 0, and the sort order (highest count first) is unchanged. Your example should now give Anna 2, Bob 1.

I haven't committed anything.
